# pdfmake 0.2.20

Vendored browser build used only for direct, client-side PDF report downloads.

- Upstream: https://github.com/bpampuch/pdfmake
- Distribution source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfmake@0.2.20/build/
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`
- `pdfmake.min.js` SHA-256: `c2fd3a5e24db096c9139bb7d266765de433b0b866d03ba356c2ef4d9ae1a53b7`
- `vfs_fonts.js` SHA-256: `f91db5690400fc851536c3a9322f822619f8e9f681abe42013e572d88d3c1f38`

The bundled Roboto virtual fonts keep the static tool independent of a CDN at runtime and preserve the Latin, Greek, and Cyrillic scripts used by its configured locales.
